page_summary:
The Maze of Death Theology is the canonical works record for PKD's primary text. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is The Maze of Death Theology (circa 1968). The archive copy runs 16 pages.

Archive summary: This unpublished primary-source document is titled "Notes on the Tench Novel" in the PDF itself, but is entered here under the project title The Maze of Death Theology because it is the theological/conceptual notes packet behind A Maze of Death.

Researchers can use this entry to trace publication context, later commentary, and relationships to other works.
